Q: Thnaks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were
involved in on a street in Katy, Texas. Can you state your full name for the record?
A: Yes, I'm the driver of the blue sedan that was involved in the accident. I'd rather keep my name off the record if
that's okay, but I'm happy to answer everything else.
Q: That's fine, we'll note you as the driver of the vehicle. Can you walk me through what happened?
A: I was heading down the two-lane road in the evening, going maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour because it was
a residential stretch and there was a lot of traffic coming out of a shopping area. The other car crossed into my lane. It
wasn't a hard impact, but we did hit nose to nose.
Q: Did you have time to brake or swerve before the impact?
A: I hit the brakes and tried to pull to the right, but there wasn't much room. It happened very quickly.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and did the airbags deploy?
A: Yes, I was belted. The airbags did not come out. The steering wheel and dashboard were jolted, and my right knee
hit the lower part of the dash.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same night and was told to see an orthopedic doctor. My knee is swollen and it
hurts when I bend it or try to put weight on it. I've been using a brace and I'm doing physical therapy twice a week
now.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the acicdent or your injuries?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble with stairs and driving for long stretches. I'd appreciate it if you could keep me
updated on the claim.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
